title: Comparative Outcomes Between Foot Cast and Short Leg Cast in the Patients With Acute Closed Fracture of Proximal Fifth Metatarsal (Zone II)
brief_summary: This study aims to compare outcomes of short leg cast and foot cast for treatment acute fifth metatarsal fracture (Zone II).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:acute closed fracture of proximal fifth metatarsal (zone II) with following criteria

1. History of trauma and pain at lateral side of foot
2. Tenderness at base of 5th metatarsal
3. Radiographic finding shown fracture line at proximal 5th metatarsal bone

Exclusion Criteria:

1. more than 1 week
2. comminuted or multiple fracture
3. Open fracture
4. Ligament and tendon injury
5. Previous injury complication: nonunion, delayed union
6. Malignancy
7. refuse to inform consent
condition: Acute Closed Fracture of Proximal Fifth Metatarsal (Zone II)
